observations: Photo 0: a black Sony PlayStation 4 console standing upright on a wooden shelf, the original large 'fat' body shape with the split top panel, not the Slim or Pro.
Photo 0: 'PS4' is printed on the top panel and 'SONY' on the front edge.
Photo 0: one black DualShock 4 controller leans against the console; only one pad is visible.
Photo 0: exterior looks clean with no visible scratches or dents from this one angle.
Photo 0: the console is not powered on; no screen, no cables, no games, no box and no receipt are shown.
Photo 0: the image carries a 'Posted on Jiji' watermark and a shop name, so it may be a dealer's display photo rather than this exact unit.
Only one photo, one angle: the back panel, ports, label with model number and storage size, and the warranty seal are not shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean exterior from one angle; other sides not shown.
Country of prior use cannot be shown in a photo; a UK plug or label would only hint at it.
Only one controller is visible in photo 0.
No power cable, HDMI cable or charging cable is shown.
No discs or game library screen shown; digital games tied to the seller's account may not transfer.
Only one angle shown; top and front look clean but back, ports and underside are not shown.
The warranty seal sticker on the back is not shown.
Console is off in photo 0; no clip of it booting, playing or the controllers working.
No receipt shown; an original-model PS4 is several years old so a live warranty is unlikely.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, may have a failing disc drive, overheating fan or HDMI port fault.
risks.proof: A clip showing the console booting to the home screen on a TV, inserting and reading a disc, and running a game for a minute.

risks.risk: Only one controller may come with it, and the controller may have stick drift or a dead battery.
risks.proof: A photo of both controllers next to the console with a handwritten code, and a clip of each pad moving the cursor.
risks.if_unproven: as console with one controller of unknown condition

risks.risk: The 10 games may be digital on the seller's account and not transfer, or the discs may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the 10 game discs laid out with the console, or a screenshot of the game library with the account that will transfer.

risks.risk: Storage size and exact model number unknown; it may be the smaller drive.
risks.proof: A photo of the label on the back or underside showing the CUH model number and capacity, or the System Information screen.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest storage original PS4

risks.risk: Console may have been opened or repaired, or be banned from the online network.
risks.proof: A close photo of the warranty seal sticker on the back, and a screenshot of a successful sign in to the online network.

risks.risk: The photo may be a dealer's stock photo and not the unit being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the console with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give.
risks.if_unproven: as the worst case original PS4 seen, with identity confirmed at collection

risks.risk: Power cable, HDMI cable and charging cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of all cables laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting to the home screen on a TV, reading a disc and running a game, with both pads in use.
Photo of the console, both controllers, all cables and the 10 game discs together with a handwritten code and today's date.
Photo of the back label showing the CUH model number and storage capacity, or the System Information screen.
Close photo of the warranty seal on the back of the console.
Photo of the receipt if it truly exists.
response.reason: The 'PS4' and 'SONY' markings and the body shape in photo 0 identify an original Sony PS4, so it can be priced at its worst case: not working, one pad, no games and the lowest storage. The unproven pads, games, accessories and working state are conditions that the listed proof would raise.
